facts.en: Completed a trade administration diploma at Fictional Silverfen Academy in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构银沼学院完成贸易行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Attended 18 sessions of an introductory Spanish evening course during 2025-02 to 2025-06.
facts.zh: 2025-02 至 2025-06 参加西班牙语夜间入门课程 18 次。

facts.en: Course attendance was recorded, but no language test, proficiency level, or fluency certificate was issued.
facts.zh: 记录了课程出勤，但未提供语言考试、熟练程度等级或流利度证书。

facts.en: Order filing clerk at Fictional Seaglass Parcel, 2021-09 to 2023-10.
facts.zh: 2021-09 至 2023-10 在虚构海玻包裹机构任订单归档文员。

facts.en: Shipping documentation assistant at Fictional Seaglass Parcel, 2023-11 to 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2023-11 至 2026-09 在虚构海玻包裹机构任运输文档助理。

facts.en: Checks shipment references and item counts across packing lists and approved commercial invoices.
facts.zh: 核对装箱单及已批准商业发票之间的货运参考编号及物品数量。

facts.en: Requests corrections from the sales coordinator; licensed external agents handle customs filings.
facts.zh: 向销售协调员请求更正；报关由持牌外部代理处理。

facts.en: Reorganized shipment document folders with a logistics colleague in 2025-04.
facts.zh: 2025-04 与物流同事共同重新整理货运文档文件夹。

facts.en: Personally standardized file names and added a missing-document flag for 32 active folders.
facts.zh: 个人统一文件命名，并为 32 个活跃文件夹添加缺失文档标记。

facts.en: During the 2025-05 check, 28 of 32 folders contained the approved packing list; this is document completeness, not customs-clearance success.
facts.zh: 2025-05 检查时，32 个文件夹中有 28 个包含已批准装箱单；此为文档完整度，而非通关成功率。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet comparisons and approved English email templates; technical translation is referred to a reviewer.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格比对及经批准的英文邮件模板；技术翻译转交审阅人员。

facts.en: Drafted a shipment milestone tracker in 2026-03; it remained a local demonstration rather than a live carrier integration.
facts.zh: 2026-03 起草货运里程碑跟踪表；仍为本地演示，并非实际承运商集成。

facts.en: Created a personal photo index of 21 imaginary lighthouses in 2024-09.
facts.zh: 2024-09 制作含 21 座假想灯塔的个人照片索引。

facts.en: Enjoys cooking and assembling wooden puzzles.
facts.zh: 爱好烹饪及拼装木制拼图。

facts.en: A draft bio describes Spanish fluency solely from course attendance; the proficiency label is unsupported.
facts.zh: 一份简介草稿仅依据课程出勤称西班牙语流利；熟练程度标签缺乏支持。

facts.en: No customs-broker licence, independent tariff classification, or certified language proficiency is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录报关代理执照、独立关税分类或经认证语言水平。
